final_message:
The test suite passes now: all 16 tests, up from 12 passing and 4 failing. The fixes are in two files under `slugkit/` and nothing else changed. I haven't committed them.

| Failing tests | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `test_unicode_folding` | Accented letters were dropped instead of folded to plain ASCII (`Crème` → `cr-me`). | In `slugkit/slug.py`, accented letters are now split into base letter plus accent mark and the marks are removed, so `é` becomes `e` (SPEC 1.1). |
| `test_punctuation_runs_collapse`, `test_custom_separator` | The pattern `[^a-z0-9]` replaced each bad character on its own, so a run like ` & ` became `---`. | Changed it to `[^a-z0-9]+` so a whole run becomes one separator (SPEC 1.2). The separator is now inserted literally, so one containing a backslash can't be misread. |
| `test_cuts_at_word_boundary` | Off by one: the search for a separator stopped one character short, so a separator sitting exactly at position `max_len` was missed. | In `slugkit/truncate.py`, the search range is now `max_len + 1`, so a cut at exactly `max_len` is allowed (SPEC 2.2). |

Run with the README command:
```
$ python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
Ran 16 tests in 0.001s
OK

$ git status --short
 M slugkit/slug.py
 M slugkit/truncate.py
```
